policy.statement: RC6 execution is not authorized as of this build: no corpus, secrets, seals, model calls, reveal or scoring. Part B stays fail-closed in the controller.

Unpublished outcomes, protected material (seals, ledgers, wire records, label salts), secrets and local machine paths are excluded from this site and its build output.

research_journey.label: RC1 to RC3 release candidates
research_journey.summary: Pipeline built, audited and frozen across three release candidates; freeze records are public tags.

research_journey.label: POST-RC3 model generalization and RC4-MULTI-V1
research_journey.summary: Sealed corpora, preregistrations and local-model evaluations; RC4 multi-target design and sealed results.

research_journey.label: RC5-GENERALIZATION-V1 design
research_journey.summary: Design phase only: target families, frozen verifier, model matrix, blinding, scoring and reproduction protocols.

research_journey.label: RC5 execution phase
research_journey.summary: Corpus binding, per-model authorizations and the execution amendment were recorded locally. The execution record and every outcome are unpublished and withheld pending the researcher's publication decision.

research_journey.label: RC6 investigation design and breakthrough criteria
research_journey.summary: Diagnostic design, hypotheses and preregistered breakthrough criteria (criteria only, no results).

research_journey.label: RC6 Part A: synthetic diagnostics
research_journey.summary: Synthetic diagnostics with 0 model calls, followed by evidence-flow design work. The Part A results document restates earlier-study figures and stays restricted.

research_journey.label: RC6 Part B readiness
research_journey.summary: Runner, decision-trace fields, guarded runtime controller, validity and replication gates, frozen analysis, runtime restore record, independent-replication preregistration (registered locally, not externally) and a fail-closed pre-push gate.

research_journey.label: RC6 Part B experiment (guarded)
research_journey.summary: Not authorized. The guard refuses runtime start, model calls, reveal and scoring; the Command Center pipeline reports the Part B step as BLOCKED until every gate and an explicit operator authorization agree.

process_flow.label: Design and preregister
process_flow.detail: Design docs, preregistration drafts and breakthrough criteria are written before any corpus, run or reveal.

process_flow.label: Freeze
process_flow.detail: Analysis code and preregistration are hash-pinned (FROZEN_ANALYSIS, prereg sha256); any change needs a recorded re-freeze.

process_flow.label: Guard
process_flow.detail: aivd_rc6_guard refuses START_RUNTIME, MODEL_CALL, REVEAL, SCORE and PUSH unless an approved record, an operator-supplied authorization and the prereg hash all agree.

process_flow.label: Local controller
process_flow.detail: A paired controller on 127.0.0.1 exposes only fixed, server-defined operations with CSRF, timeouts, a single run slot and redacted logs.

process_flow.label: One-click pipeline
process_flow.detail: preflight, guard, rc6_tests, full_suite, cc_tests, scans, model, partb, summary: each step reports PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, SKIPPED or ERROR.

process_flow.label: Part B gate
process_flow.detail: Fail closed: guard, memory, runtime hashes, model readiness and the operator's authorization must all pass before the guarded entry script may start.

process_flow.label: Reveal and score gates
process_flow.detail: G_REPLICATION and G_VALIDITY must pass before any reveal or scoring.

process_flow.label: Independent validation
process_flow.detail: A separate human reviewer validates any result. The software never asserts this state.

process_flow.label: Publication gate
process_flow.detail: RC6 pre-push checks K1 to K5, the Command Center scanners and the reports allowlist decide what can leave the machine.

process_flow.label: Static site
process_flow.detail: This read-only site shows only scanned, sanitized data.
